Reasoning: Mark the vertices according to the method stated in the problem: A is the front lower-left corner, B is the rear upper-left corner reached by the thick diagonal of the left face, C is the rear upper-right corner of the top rear edge, and D is the right rear lower corner. Take the side length of the cube as 1, and let A=(0,0,0), B=(0,1,1), C=(1,1,1), D=(1,1,0). At A, AB=(0,1,1), AD=(1,1,0), the dot product AB·AD=1, and |AB|=√2, |AD|=√2, so cos∠A=1/2, ∠A=60°. method.method_draft: Label the cube vertices from the image: let A be the front-left-bottom vertex, B the back-left-top vertex reached by the thick diagonal on the left face, C the back-right-top vertex along the thick top back edge, and D the back-right-bottom vertex along the thick right vertical edge; the final thick segment returns from D to A across the bottom face. The four marked angles are the angles of the spatial quadrilateral A-B-C-D at A, B, C, and D. Assign cube coordinates A=(0,0,0), B=(0,1,1), C=(1,1,1), D=(1,1,0). Compute each marked angle using dot products: at A, vectors AB=(0,1,1) and AD=(1,1,0) have cosine 1/2, so the angle is 60°. At B, BA is perpendicular to BC, so 90°. At C, CB is perpendicular to CD, so 90°. At D, DC is perpendicular to DA, so 90°. Sum = 60+90+90+90=330°.

在 D 处，DC=(0,0,1)，DA=(-1,-1,0)，点积为 0，所以 ∠D=90°。

因此四个标角之和为 60°+90°+90°+90°=330°。
